text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Contrato inmutable de evento.
11 tipos (audit_created → audit_completed).
Validación UUID v4 + ISO-8601.
Versioned: versionExtractor, versionNormalizer, versionRules.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Publica eventos al stream correcto.
Mapeo tipo → stream (STREAM_BY_TYPE).
Rechaza rules_evaluated para impedir bypass.
Stream DLQ configurable via AUDIT_DLQ_STREAM.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Base Template Method para todos los workers.
XREADGROUP + XACK + retry counter.
xAutoClaim para pending messages (crash recovery).
DLQ tras AUDIT_EVENT_MAX_RETRIES (default: 3).
SIGTERM/SIGINT graceful shutdown.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Estado mutable de la auditoría en Redis.
Scripts Lua atómicos: MERGE, REGISTER_DOCUMENT,
DOCUMENT_TRANSITION, STORE_RULES_EVALUATION, COMPLETE_AUDIT.
TTL 24h por auditoría.
Estados: pending → processing → completed/failed.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Consume: audit_created de audit.inbox.
Lee FDV vía AuditDataService.
Construye audit-config desde AuditConfigModel.
Crea extraction_contract con DocumentExtractionContractBuilder.
Publica N × document_registered.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Builder dinámico de Function Declarations.
4 funciones paralelas: extract_fields, extract_items,
detect_visual_checks, assess_document_quality.
Hash de contrato para invalidación de cache.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Consume: document_registered de audit.documents.
Descarga adjunto (Drive URL o BLOB via sqlsrv).
sha256(file_content) → ExtractionCache en Redis.
Construye prompt + files inline.
GeminiGateway.sendWithFunctionCalling().
Publica document_extracted.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Perfil extraction: requiere archivos inline.
Perfil semantic_match: solo texto.
Retry exponencial (3 intentos, 429/503/500/502/504).
Circuit Breaker Redis (cb:gemini:state/fails).
Debug log en responseIA/ por cada llamada.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Consume: document_extracted de audit.documents.
Normalización determinista:
- Fechas → ISO-8601
- Texto → UPPERCASE sin tildes/diacríticos
- Numéricos → canonical float
- Vacíos → null
Publica document_normalized.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Compara campos extraídos vs FDV.
5 veredictos: COINCIDE / VALOR_DISTINTO /
NO_ENCONTRADO / OMITIDO / NO_CONCLUYENTE.
AuditFieldValueType para comparación tipada.
SemanticMatchJudge como fallback de homologación.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Homologación semántica de artículos.\nUsa perfil semantic_match (sin archivos).\nDevuelve: COINCIDE | VALOR_DISTINTO | NO_CONCLUYENTE.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Consume: document_normalized/rejected.
Invoca DocumentPolicyEngine por documento.
Guarda el outcome canónico.
Encola rules_evaluated cuando termina la auditoría.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Único productor de audit.persistence:{queue}.
Deduplica por audit_id.
Un evento activo por job.
Promueve el siguiente al cerrar el turno.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Consume: rules_evaluated de audit.persistence:{queue}.
Valida el outcome canónico.
Persiste SQL, cierra Redis y libera el turno.
Publica audit_completed | audit_failed.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Transacción única:
→ UPSERT serializable dbo.AudDispEst
→ UPDATE set-based AdjuntosDispensacion
→ UPDATE trazabilidad DispensacionDetalleServicio

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan: Rastrea progreso de auditorías en lote.\nCampos: total, completed, errors, status.\nTTL configurable via AUDIT_CACHE_TTL.
